zoe_cs: Alert — Avalon onboarding burn jumped overnight, embeddings are the primary offender (~3.2x). Need a fast safety plan + a one-slide QBR blurb.
mark_finops: On it. Can we get route % and an estimated 7-day run if unchanged?
raj_se: Quick console pull: /v1/embeddings = 79% of tokens. Current pace ~1.7M tokens/day -> ~11.9M over 7d. Looks like their nightly indexer did a full reindex.
zoe_cs: Immediate asks: 1) temporary credit buffer, 2) route-level soft cap for embeddings, 3) swap to snapshot-run for indexer if possible, 4) 30-min enablement tomorrow.
mark_finops: I recommend a 20% buffer and alerts at 65%/85% of that buffer. I'll compute token-to-dollar impact for the QBR slide.
anya_enablement: I can run the enablement session. Will cover batching, incremental refresh patterns, and caching TTLs. Morning PT works.
raj_se: Mitigation steps: set soft cap /v1/embeddings -> 800k tokens/day, enable snapshot-mode for indexer, add prefix caching. Implementing now.
notify-bot: Created alert "avalon-embed-buffer-65-85" (ID: NB-3200). Playbook:
```
1) grant 20% temp credit buffer
2) set /v1/embeddings soft cap 800k/day
3) switch indexer to snapshot mode
4) schedule enablement + 24h follow-up
```
zoe_cs: Please draft a single-line QBR bullet: root cause + mitigation + next step. Keep it concise.
raj_se: Draft: "Root cause: full reindex produced dense embedding calls; Mitigation: snapshot + soft cap + enablement; Next: monitor 24h and clear renewal flag if stable."
mark_finops: I'll add cost deltas and cushion math to the slide. Buffer provisioned and alerts live.
anya_enablement: I'll record the session and attach a 1-page playbook with example batching configs.
zoe_cs: Owners: mark_finops -> buffer & slide, raj_se -> caps & cache, anya_enablement -> enablement. Re-evaluating renewal risk in 24h. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
